a.lede: Eclypsium's November InfraTrust report warns that most infrastructure security advisories addressing exploited vulnerabilities over the past month involve flaws in third-party software bundled into products rather than code developed by the vendors themselves. [...]
a.title: InfraTrust warns of exploited supply chain flaws in network appliances

b.lede: The British cyber agency says that "building strong foundations has never mattered more" as AI hacking tools rely on exploiting simple security flaws.
b.title: UK warns AI-driven cyberattacks are exposing years of weak security
